# Screenloop

> Screenloop is an AI-native ATS platform that combines applicant tracking, interview intelligence, and recruitment automation to help teams make better hiring decisions.

Screenloop provides a comprehensive recruitment platform featuring AI-powered interview analysis, modern referencing, background checks, and hiring analytics. The platform serves startups and scaling companies looking to streamline talent acquisition and improve quality of hire through intelligent automation and data-driven insights.

## Key Topics

- AI ATS
- Interview Intelligence
- Recruitment Automation
- Quality of Hire
- Candidate Evaluation
- Hiring Analytics
- Talent Operations
- Pulse (NPS)
- Background Checks
- References
- Interviewer Training
- Recruitment Metrics
- Cost Per Hire
- Talent Acquisition
- Candidate Feedback

## Core Platform

- [Screenloop | AI ATS with Interview Intelligence & Automation](https://www.screenloop.com): Screenloop homepage showcasing AI-native ATS platform with interview intelligence and automation
- [Screenloop | AI ATS with Interview Intelligence & Automation](https://www.screenloop.com/product/ats): Core ATS platform page for applicant tracking and recruitment automation
- [Screenloop | Interview Intelligence and AI Notetaker](https://www.screenloop.com/product/interview-intelligence): Interview Intelligence product featuring AI Notetaker for recording and analyzing interviews
- [Screenloop | Data & Analytics](https://www.screenloop.com/platform/data-analytics): Data & Analytics platform for recruitment metrics, dashboards, and hiring insights

## Talent Assessment & Evaluation

- [Screenloop | Modern Referencing & Soft Skill Analysis](https://www.screenloop.com/product/references): References product for modern referencing and soft-skills assessment in hiring
- [Screenloop | Background Checks Made Easy | Fast, Compliant & Comprehensive](https://www.screenloop.com/product/background-checks): Background checks product with compliance, criminal records, and employment verification
- [Screenloop | Interviewer Training](https://www.screenloop.com/product/interviewer-training): Interviewer training module for bias-free, high-quality interview techniques
- [Screenloop | Pulse | Candidate & Hiring Team NPS](https://www.screenloop.com/product/pulse): Pulse product for measuring candidate NPS and hiring team experience feedback
